concepts.name: Kinematics
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: The description of motion in terms of position, velocity, and acceleration.
learning_objectives: Derive and apply the equations of motion for constant acceleration.

concepts.name: Newton's Laws of Motion
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: The three laws relating force, mass, and acceleration.
learning_objectives: Apply Newton's three laws to analyze forces on simple systems.

concepts.name: Work and Energy
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Work, kinetic energy, potential energy, and conservation of energy.
learning_objectives: Apply the work-energy theorem and conservation of energy to solve problems.

concepts.name: Momentum and Collisions
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Linear momentum, impulse, and conservation of momentum in collisions.
learning_objectives: Apply conservation of momentum to elastic and inelastic collisions.

concepts.name: Rotational Motion
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Angular velocity, torque, and rotational analogs of linear motion.
learning_objectives: Apply torque and angular momentum concepts to rotating rigid bodies.

concepts.name: Orbital Mechanics
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Gravitational orbits, Kepler's laws, and satellite motion.
learning_objectives: Derive orbital parameters from gravitational force and Kepler's laws.

concepts.name: Oscillations and Waves
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Simple harmonic motion and the basic properties of mechanical waves.
learning_objectives: Model simple harmonic motion and describe basic wave properties.

concepts.name: Optics
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Reflection, refraction, and basic wave behavior of light.
learning_objectives: Apply the laws of reflection and refraction to simple optical systems.

concepts.name: Thermodynamics Basics
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Temperature, heat, and the first and second laws of thermodynamics.
learning_objectives: Apply the first law of thermodynamics to simple thermal systems.

concepts.name: Introduction to Statistical Mechanics
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Connecting microscopic particle behavior to macroscopic thermodynamic quantities.
learning_objectives: Relate probability distributions of microstates to macroscopic temperature and entropy.

concepts.name: Electrostatics
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Electric charge, electric fields, and Coulomb's law.
learning_objectives: Apply Coulomb's law and the concept of electric field to point charges.

concepts.name: Electric Circuits
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Current, voltage, resistance, and basic circuit analysis.
learning_objectives: Analyze simple series and parallel resistive circuits.

concepts.name: Electromagnetic Induction
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Faraday's law and the generation of electric current from changing magnetic fields.
learning_objectives: Apply Faraday's law to calculate induced EMF in changing magnetic fields.

concepts.name: Special Relativity
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Time dilation, length contraction, and the postulates of special relativity.
learning_objectives: Apply the postulates of special relativity to compute time dilation and length contraction.

concepts.name: Introduction to Quantum Mechanics
concepts.subject: physics
concepts.description: Wave-particle duality, the Schrodinger equation, and quantization of observables.
learning_objectives: Interpret the wavefunction and apply the Schrodinger equation to simple systems.
